fitted_on: validation partition (disjoint from fit and test)
note: Isotonic alone is monotone non-decreasing and ties raw scores together, which perturbs AUC-PR. A tanh tie-break of size 1e-6 restores strict monotonicity, so ranking, AUC-PR, AUC-ROC and the tuned operating point are all preserved exactly. ece_validation_in_sample is near zero by construction and proves nothing; read ece_test_out_of_sample.
